_meta.asset: AXG Dimensions Lookup + Retrofit / Replacement Advisor
_meta.purpose: Phase-2 truth-layer tables. (1) Yokogawa AXG lay lengths for fitment answers. (2) Competitor cross-reference so the agent can tell a customer whether an AXG drops into an existing competitor spool.
_meta.status: PILOT DRAFT - requires verification (see _verification on each table)

yokogawa_dimensions._note: Yokogawa AXG lay length (face-to-face). The wafer values were cross-checked against datasheet GS 01E22A01-01EN and MATCH on every overlapping size (1in=2.30, 1.5in=2.69, 2in=3.09, 3in=4.66, 4in=5.84, and the 2.5/5/10/15mm rows=3.11). That agreement is the second-source confirmation.
yokogawa_dimensions._verification: BOTH columns now VERIFIED against the datasheet flange/wafer dimension tables (GS 01E22A01-01EN pp. 81-82, 2026-06-10). Flanged column matched the prior Allied data exactly on every size. 20in = 23.62 in (600 mm) datasheet-confirmed.
yokogawa_dimensions._ring_addition_note: IMPORTANT: these lay lengths are the BARE meter (no grounding rings). When optional grounding rings are selected, add the ring value from 'grounding_ring_lay_length_additions' below to get the effective face-to-face for fitment.

grounding_ring_lay_length_additions._note: Add to the bare lay length L (total for both ends) when grounding rings are selected. Source: datasheet flanged dimension table p. 82, verified 2026-06-10.
grounding_ring_lay_length_additions._fitment_significance: Thin-type (your /GRL default) adds only ~0.08-0.16 in - within the drop-in tolerance, effectively negligible. But ELECTRODE-TYPE rings add 1.1-1.6 in, which BLOWS the fit tolerance - a retrofit with electrode-type grounding must use effective (L + ring) for fitment, not bare L.

wafer.max_size_rule: Wafer construction is not offered above 8 in by ANY manufacturer. Requests for 10 in or larger wafer are invalid - the agent must redirect to flanged, not search for a lay length.

competitor_crossref._note: Competitor lay lengths for retrofit assessment. Keyed on (manufacturer, size, connection). Empty cells = data not collected / connection not offered by that maker.
competitor_crossref._verification: STAMP REQUIRED: competitor specs drift between product generations (note Foxboro 'Old' vs '9700/New' already differ materially). Every competitor figure needs a 'verified-as-of [date]' before it backs a fitment promise. Confirm WHICH generation the customer has before quoting a fit.
competitor_crossref.verified_as_of: DATE NOT SET - fill in when figures are confirmed

fit_verdict_logic._note: How the agent turns a lay-length delta into a customer-facing verdict. delta = yokogawa - competitor. drop_in_tolerance CONFIRMED by Allied at 1/4 in (2026-06-10).

flanged.drop_in: abs(delta) <= 0.25 -> 'Direct drop-in. Gasket tolerance absorbs the difference; fits the existing spool.'
flanged.yokogawa_longer: delta > 0.25 -> 'Existing spool is too short. The pipe must be lengthened/re-fabricated to fit. Flag as added cost.' (HARD fitment problem)
flanged.yokogawa_shorter: delta < -0.25 -> 'Fits, but leaves a gap. A spacer spool piece or longer studs are needed.' (manageable)

wafer._principle: Wafer sandwiches between the customer's flanges with through-bolts, so fitment depends on the customer's flange gap, not the old meter. Shorter is always fine; only an unusually longer unit is a concern.
wafer.fits: yokogawa <= competitor + 0.25 -> 'Fits. Confirm stud/bolt length only.'
wafer.check: yokogawa > competitor + 0.25 -> 'Verify flange gap and stud length.'

retrofit_rules.rule: Replacing a Rosemount 8705 at 10 in or 12 in (flanged) with an AXG: Yokogawa is LONGER (10in: 17.54 vs 15.00 = +2.54; 12in: 19.51 vs 18.01 = +1.50). Existing spool is too short - pipe modification required. Always flag this as added cost, do not promise a clean drop-in.
For all other flanged competitor/size pairs in the table, Yokogawa runs ~0.1 in shorter than Foxboro, Endress, and Rosemount. Within tolerance = direct drop-in. (Shorter is the safe direction.)

Endress 20 in flanged (25.60) is ~2 in LONGER than the Yokogawa 20 in (23.62, confirmed). Replacing an Endress 20 in with an AXG leaves a ~2 in gap - fits dimensionally (shorter), but needs a spacer spool piece or longer hardware. Flag accordingly.
Wafer is not available above 8 in for any manufacturer. A request for wafer at 10 in or larger is invalid - redirect the customer to flanged rather than attempting a lay-length lookup.
Foxboro 'Old' and '9700/New' lay lengths differ materially (e.g. 1 in wafer: 2.81 old vs 2.13 new). Always establish which generation the customer has before assessing fit.
On wafer, Yokogawa is meaningfully shorter than Foxboro (2in: 3.09 vs 3.94 new; 3in: 4.66 vs 5.91). Fitment is fine (sandwich construction), but set expectations that it is not a dimensional match.

replacement_model._note: Yokogawa offers a dedicated WAFER REPLACEMENT MODEL - a curated subset of the AXG built for dropping into an existing installation. When the retrofit advisor concludes a wafer retrofit fits, THIS is the product to quote, not the standard catalog model.

mandatory_code.desc: With Grounding Rings For Wafer Type Replacement Model
mandatory_code.rule: MANDATORY on every wafer replacement model. The base code is incomplete without it.

curated_subset_vs_standard.sizes: Common sizes only: 25, 40, 50, 80, 100, 150, 200 mm (not the full 2.5-400 range).
curated_subset_vs_standard.connection: Wafer only: AA1 (ASME 150), AA2 (ASME 300), AG1 (JIS F12, 80-200), AJ1 (JIS 10K), AJ2 (JIS 20K). No EN, no JPI.
curated_subset_vs_standard.grounding: Grounding Rings only (code 2). No 'None' or 'Built-in' option - rings are forced.
curated_subset_vs_standard.explosion: IECEx (SF2/SJ2/ST2), FM (FF2/FJ2/FT2), Japan (JF5), NEPSI (NF2/NJ2/NT2), Korea (PF2), INMETRO (UF2/UJ2/UT2). NOT offered: ATEX (K-codes), FMc Canada (C-codes), EAC (G-codes).

replacement_model.house_defaults_compatible: Allied defaults hold: FF2 and AA1 are both in the replacement subset. A typical Allied wafer replacement = standard build + /RW/GAN.
replacement_model.advisor_integration: When fit_verdict returns a wafer drop-in, recommend the Replacement Model (with mandatory /RW/GAN) rather than the standard catalog model.
